travel_options.description: Take the Outer Ring Road (ORR) from Shamshabad, exit at the Bongloor or Sagar Road junction, and head towards the Inner Ring Road at Champapet. Travel time is around 35 to 45 minutes.
Take the official airport luxury bus towards the LB Nagar route. Drop off at LB Nagar, and take an auto-rickshaw directly to the temple.

metro.description: The nearest Metro Station is LB Nagar Metro Station (Red Line), located approximately 3.5 km away. From there, city buses, auto-rickshaws, and sharing autos are directly available to the temple gates.

Ornate pink-hued structure dedicated to the 8 forms of Lakshmi
Ancient stone watchtower dating back centuries
Prominent Marwari-style marble temple dedicated to Khatu Shyam, located directly opposite Kachiguda Railway Station
